title: Flows: per-slot model picker for every interchangeable-model slot
description: A FlowDef slot that holds more than one model must offer the user a labelled dropdown, whether or not any member is installed, with the recommended member marked. Generalises MPI-590's Krea 2 any-of pair to N slots x N members, so a flow can let the user pick the image model for one phase of its graph and the edit model for another.
